blocks.text: WASHINGTON, United States — A Republican lawmaker moved Monday to impeach US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth over the war in Iran, setting up a potentially explosive vote in Congress days after President Donald Trump’s party suffered a crushing midterm defeat. Kentucky Rep. Thomas Massie introduced eight articles of impeachment accusing Hegseth of illegally waging war
